tags.name: SS Stavronikita
tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-07-12: cross-checked build history (Denmark, 1956, originally named Ohio), fire (26 Aug 1976, 6 dead, 24 survivors adrift 4 days), auction ($30,000, 24 Oct 1977) and sinking (21 Nov 1978, US Navy demolition, 7 charges/200lb) against adrex.com and additional dive-press coverage; all core facts confirmed by 2+ sources. Flagged a minor length discrepancy in markdown (sources give 111-112m consistently, one outlier source gives 120m).
